final_message: Fallback routing incorrectly populated `MatchedPath` with its internal catch-all pattern, causing nested `ServeDir` services to panic. Fixed normal and inherited fallback dispatch to skip matched-path registration while preserving it for actual routes. Added regression tests; all 89 targeted tests pass.
